approved_scope.title: Teach archive-first closeout: verify, human review, native review, finalize, then push and observe CI (122, D5)
approved_scope.description: Teach archive-first closeout: verify, human review, native review, finalize, then push and observe CI (122, D5)
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Audit finding D5 (#122): the workflow guidance told agents to push and wait for CI before the human review and finalize, which the archive-first CI gate refuses; documentation and guidance fix, no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: Every place that teaches the closeout (bundled and installed lifecycle and accept references, docs/lifecycle.md, the walkthrough and the diagram) puts pushing and observing CI after local verification, the human implementation review, the native review and finalize, keeping the no-intervening-commit rule; installed 0.4.0 copies update; the exercise runs the corrected closeout against the archive-first inspector, which refuses the open change and passes once archived. The new test fails first, and fledge lanes run verify and the exercise pass on Linux.

answers.constraints: Issue #122 (audit D5, counterpart spec-sync#881); Leif: C1 first after KNOW-23 (2026-11-05 18:22 MST, via the orc); FLOW-10 and the no-intervening-commit rule unchanged.
